# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I need a little help with an order.

I had a whole “remote work in Seattle, become one with nature” plan going on, so I ordered a few home office things plus some hiking stuff. Now my company has decided, very rudely, that I’m going back to the office soon.

So I wanted to see if it’s possible to cancel or return just part of the order — specifically the office items — and keep the hiking gear. I honestly don’t remember exactly which items in the order were the office ones, so I’ll need your help identifying them.

A couple things I want to know:
- If partial cancellation/return is possible, how much would I get back in total?
- Can the refund go back to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then forget it, I’ll just keep the order and let destiny laugh at me. But in that case, I do want to update my default profile address to the Seattle parent house that’s already listed on the order. I’d rather not type the full address out here if you can avoid making me do that.

My name is Noah Patel. I’m currently in New York, zip 10108. I don’t remember which email I used, unfortunately.
noah_patel_6952

Thanks, Noah — I found your account and authenticated you.

I can help identify the office items and check whether a partial cancellation or return is possible, plus whether the refund can go back to the original payment method.

Your account has these orders:
- #W1845024
- #W7043598
- #W6111398

I don’t yet know which of these is the Seattle order with the office and hiking items. Please tell me which order you want me to review. If you’re not sure, I can check them one by one for you.

Also, if partial cancellation/return isn’t possible, I can update your default profile address to the same address already on that order without making you retype it. Before I make any address change, I’ll list the details and ask for your confirmation.

Thanks, I appreciate it.

I’m not sure which one is the Seattle order — my brain has been running on anxiety and coffee, so the order numbers are just looking like lottery tickets to me right now.

Can you check them one by one and find the one that has both:
- three home office items, and
- some hiking items,
and is going to the Seattle address?

Once you find that one, please tell me:
- which items look like the office items,
- whether I can cancel/return just those,
- how much I’d get back total, and
- whether it would go back to my original payment method.

And yeah, if that partial thing isn’t possible, then please use that same order’s Seattle address for my default profile address — but definitely show me the details first before changing it.
